verdict.rationale: Recruitee's features page lists an "AI & Automation" category and a separate "Reporting & Insights" category, which hints at AI-assisted functionality inside the product. Neither item describes AI-generated insights or suggestions drawn from the user's data, and the reporting feature is not shown to be AI-driven. Missing for 10: any documentation of what the AI features actually do, evidence that AI generates insights or suggestions from candidate/pipeline data, examples of in-product AI recommendations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
